'''Zoé Maria Chatzidakis''' (3 April 1955 – 22 January 2025) was a French mathematician who worked as a director of research at the [[École Normale Supérieure]] in Paris, France.<ref>[https://www.math.ens.fr/-Membres- Member directory], ENS/DMA, retrieved 2 July 2016.</ref>

== Life and career ==
Chatzidakis was born on 3 April 1955.<ref name=inmem>{{Cite web |date=23 January 2025 |title=In Memoriam: Dr. Zoé Chatzidakis |url=https://www.fields.utoronto.ca/news/Memoriam-Dr-Zo%C3%A9-Chatzidakis |access-date=24 January 2025 |website=Fields Institute for Research in Mathematical Sciences |language=en}}</ref> She earned her [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] in 1984 from [[Yale University]], under the supervision of [[Angus Macintyre]], with a dissertation on the model theory of [[profinite group]]s.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=82670}}.</ref> She was Senior researcher and team director in [[Algebra]] and [[Geometry]] in the Département de mathématiques et applications de l'[[École Normale Supérieure]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mathematics at Ecole Normale Supérieure - Algebra and Geometry|url=http://www.math.ens.fr/-Algebra-Geometry-|access-date=7 June 2021|website=www.math.ens.fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Gestion membre|url=http://www.math.ens.fr/fiche-membre/fiche-membre-en.php?id_membre=288|access-date=7 June 2021|website=www.math.ens.fr}}</ref>

Her research concerned [[model theory]] and [[difference algebra]]. She was invited to give the [[Tarski Lectures]] in 2020, though the lectures were postponed due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=The Tarski Lectures {{!}} Department of Mathematics at University of California Berkeley|url=https://math.berkeley.edu/about/events/lectures/tarski|access-date=2 November 2021|website=math.berkeley.edu|quote="Update on March 10th 2020: The event has been postponed to next year"}}</ref>

Chatzidakis died on 22 January 2025 in Paris at the age of 69.<ref name=inmem/>

== Honours and awards ==
Chatzidakis was the 2013 winner of the [[Leconte Prize]],<ref>[http://www.academie-sciences.fr/archivage_site/activite/prix/laureat_leconte_math10.pdf Leconte Prize citation] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230914201209/https://www.academie-sciences.fr/archivage_site/activite/prix/laureat_leconte_math10.pdf |date=14 September 2023 }}, [[French Academy of Sciences]], retrieved 2 July 2016.</ref> and was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2014.<ref>[http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171124141541/http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php |date=24 November 2017 }}, [[International Mathematical Union]], retrieved 2 July 2016.</ref> She was named [[Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|MSRI]] Chern Professor for Fall 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|last=MSRI|title=Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|url=http://www.msri.org/|access-date=7 June 2021|website=www.msri.org}}</ref>
